mapper.sql: c.case_id, c.order_id, c.case_no, o.order_no, c.case_type, c.case_status, c.problem_desc, c.lost_items_json, c.compensation_amount, c.platform_ticket_no, c.customer_contacted, c.create_time, c.finish_time, c.remark
mapper.select: select from ry_business.ry_rental_after_sales_case c inner join ry_business.ry_rental_order o on o.order_id = c.order_id and o.tenant_id = c.tenant_id and o.member_id = c.member_id and o.is_delete = 0 where c.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and c.member_id = #{memberId} and c.case_no = #{caseNo} and c.is_delete = 0 limit 1 for update

select from ry_business.ry_rental_after_sales_case c inner join ry_business.ry_rental_order o on o.order_id = c.order_id and o.tenant_id = c.tenant_id and o.member_id = c.member_id and o.is_delete = 0 where c.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and c.member_id = #{memberId} and c.order_id = #{orderId} and c.case_status = 0 and c.is_delete = 0 order by c.case_id desc limit 1 for update
mapper.insert: insert into ry_business.ry_rental_after_sales_case (tenant_id, member_id, order_id, case_no, case_type, case_status, problem_desc, lost_items_json, compensation_amount, customer_contacted, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark, is_delete) values (#{tenantId}, #{memberId}, #{orderId}, #{caseNo}, #{command.caseType}, 0, #{command.problemDesc}, #{command.lostItemsJson}, #{command.compensationAmount}, coalesce(#{command.customerContacted}, 0), #{operatorId}, now(), #{operatorId}, now(), #{command.remark}, 0)

insert into ry_business.ry_rental_after_sales_event (tenant_id, member_id, case_id, event_type, from_status, to_status, content, operator_name, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, is_delete) values (#{tenantId}, #{memberId}, #{caseId}, #{eventType}, #{fromStatus}, #{toStatus}, #{content}, #{operatorName}, #{operatorId}, now(), #{operatorId}, now(), 0)

insert into ry_business.ry_rental_after_sales_evidence (tenant_id, member_id, case_id, evidence_type, file_url, file_name, file_mime, description, operator_name, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, is_delete) values (#{tenantId}, #{memberId}, #{caseId}, #{evidenceType}, #{fileUrl}, #{fileName}, #{fileMime}, #{description}, #{operatorName}, #{operatorId}, now(), #{operatorId}, now(), 0)
